mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 declined by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a strong supply-side response, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 70% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable economic environment, which reduces uncertainty and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL was below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a strong demand for housing, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 10% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises & PAYEMS declines > 100,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE rose and PAYEMS declined by more than 100,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month for three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% MoM for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% month-over-month for three consecutive months.
